facts.text: Students applying Early Decision receive guaranteed tuition of no more than $19,000 per year for up to four years, plus guaranteed housing for two years.

sources.title: Early Decision vs Early Action - Hawaii Pacific University
sources.quote: Guaranteed tuition – tuition no more than $19,000 a year, for up to four years. Guaranteed housing years one and two.

facts.text: HPU's waterfront campus utilizes the Aloha Tower Marketplace for student housing at Harbor Lofts, classrooms, and dining.

sources.title: The 'Ohana | Aloha Tower Voted as 'Hawai'i's Favorite Building'
sources.quote: The University's Aloha Tower Marketplace houses HPU student housing at its Harbor Lofts, classrooms, dining rooms, its HPU eSports Arena, Sharkey's Cove, and Pier 9 by Sam Choy, which provides healthy, tasty meals to students living on campus.
